posts.author: Xero3C
posts.body:
Hello,
I'm making a monster-taming game based on my home-country, similar to Pokémon (but with a unique battle system and more) and as I'm starting with RPG Maker MZ, I wanted to ask if there is a possibilty to seamlessly transition between different maps?
I come from making Pokémon fangames with RPG Maker XP & Essentials and there you could choose to connect maps, so that, when you enter a new map, they feel as if you made 1 big map, but in reality you made 2 smaller maps and it feels like an openworld.
When I do the Transfer Player in RPG Maker MZ, even with Fade set to None there is still a small, but noticable cut, which looks like the player teleported somewhere else and in this context it looks kinda akward.
I also tried this plugin:
https://forums.rpgmakerweb.com/inde...map-transition-scroll-type-compatible.141765/
, but it only works on 1 map, by cutting it into smaller pieces, but it's not connecting different maps with each other, at least not that I know.
The reason, why I wanted to multiple smaller maps is bc I sometimes need to change 1 or more tilesets. F.ex. the E-Tileset from Map 1 has country side houses, while the E-Tileset from Map 2 has a barn and a tractor.
PS: I only used some Pokémon Sprites as placeholder graphics. They will be replaced along development.
Thank you very much for your help already
